question: Which of the following places of India can have maximum temperature difference between the day and night?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Jaisalmer__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jaisalmer **can have maximum temperature difference between **the day and night**.
 
• **The diurnal temperature range **refers to the difference between the **maximum and minimum temperatures **recorded during the same day.
 
• This range is influenced by factors such as **high daytime temperatures **and** low nighttime temperatures**.
 
• In areas located far from the sea, especially where solar radiation is intense, the diurnal temperature range tends to be higher. Jaisalmer, situated in the state of Rajasthan in Northern India, experiences such conditions.
 
• With low-pressure systems prevailing, hot dry winds and dust storms are common, serving to counterbalance the low-pressure conditions. These regions receive minimal rainfall, with Jaisalmer recording an annual rainfall of less than 20 cm.
 
• Consequently, diurnal temperatures can soar up to 45°C. Jaisalmer's climate is characterized by sweltering, humid, and windy summers, short and cool winters, and predominantly dry and clear conditions throughout the year.
 
• The temperature typically varies from **47°F to 108°F** over the course of the year, with rare occurrences of temperatures below 42°F or above 113°F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **In Thiruvananthapuram,** the average temperature hovers around 27°C, with variations observed throughout the year. During the monsoon season in August, temperatures dip to around 26°C, while they rise to about 29°C in April during the summer months.
 
• **Port Blair** experiences distinct seasons, with the wet season characterized by windiness and overcast skies, while the dry season tends to be partly cloudy. 
 
• **Kanyakumari **shares similarities with Thiruvananthapuram in terms of climate patterns. The average temperature in Kanyakumari is approximately 26°C, with fluctuations observed across seasons.
